name: Bubbs Creek Wall
overview: A remote High Sierra granite wall above the Bubbs Creek drainage, reached by a long approach from Road's End. Its small route roster is made up of committing, full-day alpine-style trad objectives with roughly 14 to 19 pitches.
monthly_notes: May: Late May can be pleasant once the Road's End approach is open, but lingering snow and high creek flows remain possible. Verify current road, trail, and backcountry conditions. | June: June offers long days and is often a strong window, though the sunny wall can become hot later in summer. | September: September can bring crisp climbing conditions, but shorter days and early Sierra storms make conservative timing important.

name: Patterson Left
overview: A roughly 1,000-foot, southwest-facing granite cliff at Patterson Bluff. Most routes are long trad lines, with a small number of bolted objectives; access normally starts at the top and involves rappelling into the wall.
monthly_notes: May: The seasonal access road generally reopens around May 1; confirm current road status before the trip. | October: October is one of the most reliable windows for comfortable temperatures on the southwest-facing wall. | November: November is typically climbable before the seasonal road closure, which normally begins December 1.

name: Trout Creek
overview: A premier Central Oregon crack-climbing area on tall basalt columns, known for physical corners, stem boxes, and a strong traditional ethic. The entire climbing area is closed annually from January 15 through August 31 for nesting golden eagles; always verify the current closure before visiting.
monthly_notes: January: Only the first half of January is normally available, weather permitting; the annual full-area closure begins January 15. | February: Closed: the entire climbing area is under its annual golden-eagle protection closure from January 15 through August 31. | March: Closed: the entire climbing area is under its annual golden-eagle protection closure from January 15 through August 31. | April: Closed: the entire climbing area is under its annual golden-eagle protection closure from January 15 through August 31. | May: Closed: the entire climbing area is under its annual golden-eagle protection closure from January 15 through August 31. | June: Closed: the entire climbing area is under its annual golden-eagle protection closure from January 15 through August 31. | July: Closed: the entire climbing area is under its annual golden-eagle protection closure from January 15 through August 31. | August: Closed through August 31 under the annual golden-eagle protection closure; verify the current BLM notice before visiting. | September: The area normally reopens September 1. Check the current BLM notice before traveling, then expect a strong early-fall window. | October: October is a prime month for the west-facing wall, with cooler temperatures and more dependable crack-climbing conditions. | November: November is another prime window, though shorter days and cold spells make an early start useful. | December: December can offer good sun on the west-facing wall, but short days and cold spells make conditions less dependable.

name: The Grail
overview: A mostly shady limestone wall in Lime Kiln Canyon with long, vertical-to-slightly-overhanging sport routes and a dense concentration of 5.12 climbing. Most lines are single-pitch, though a few multipitch routes and midway anchors make a 70- or 80-meter rope especially useful.
monthly_notes: February: February can be a good shoulder-season option, but the mostly shady wall may stay cold after winter weather. | March: March is a prime spring month in Lime Kiln Canyon, with the shaded wall helping on warmer afternoons. | April: April remains a strong spring window before the Arizona Strip becomes too hot for dependable climbing. | May: May can still work on this shaded wall, but start early and expect heat to reduce the reliable climbing window. | October: A strong fall window returns in October after the summer heat; the mostly shady wall can feel cool late in the day. | November: November is a prime fall month, though the wall's shade makes warm layers useful.
